alt: 孩子低聲猜疑園丁的籃子藏有皇冠，實際打開的籃子裡只有幼苗和小鏟子。
scene_prompt: In a park, an anxious child whispers an invented suspicion to a friend while looking at a distant ordinary gardener carrying an opaque closed basket. A soft translucent imagination vignette above the child shows a fantastical pile of stolen jeweled crowns inside that basket; in the clearly separate actual foreground, the gardener has just set the real basket open and it contains only ordinary seedlings and a trowel. The suspicious child has not looked at this real evidence. Clear unsupported fanciful assumption contradicted by visible mundane reality. No text, criminal accusation dialogue or wind-catching literalism.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper.
